pages.body:
# MessMate

Flutter app with a FastAPI backend that shows the hostel mess menu and lets students rate meals. State management: Riverpod. Database: PostgreSQL.

# JLPT N4 preparation

Learning Japanese for the JLPT N4 exam in July 2027: katakana done, kanji and grammar next.

# Portfolio site

Personal portfolio in Next.js and Tailwind, deployed on Vercel.

# MessMate database: PostgreSQL, not MongoDB

Chose PostgreSQL over MongoDB for MessMate because menus, students and payments need joins.

# OS exam book: Galvin

Follow Galvin (Operating System Concepts) for the OS exam; Tanenbaum only for deadlocks.
